exampleHtml:
Example: APY calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Convert: APR → APY
  • Rate: 5% APR
  • Compounding: Daily
  • Deposit: $10,000
  • Years: 1

The calculator returns:

  • APY: 5.127% (5% APR, daily)
  • Balance after 1 yr: $10,513
  • Interest earned: $512.67
  • APR: 5%
  • Compounding boost: +0.127% (APY minus APR)
